bank.name: Quranic Facts & Revelation
bank.subject: Islamic Studies
bank.description: How the Quran was revealed, compiled and preserved, plus key facts.

questions.prompt: The first revelation was received on which night?
questions.explanation: The Quran began to be revealed on Laylat-ul-Qadr (the Night of Power) in Ramadan.

questions.prompt: Under which caliph was the Quran first compiled into a single book (Mushaf)?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr, on Umar's advice, ordered the first compilation of the Quran into a single Mushaf after the Battle of Yamama.

questions.prompt: Who was appointed by Abu Bakr to compile the Quran?
questions.explanation: Zaid bin Thabit, a young scribe of the Prophet (PBUH), was tasked with compiling the Quran.

questions.prompt: Who ordered the standardization of the Quranic script and sent copies to different cities?
questions.explanation: Caliph Uthman standardized the Quranic text and distributed official copies to prevent recitation differences.

questions.prompt: What is the first word of the first revelation?
questions.explanation: The first revealed word was 'Iqra' (Read), the opening of Surah Al-Alaq.

questions.prompt: Which Surah was revealed last according to most scholars?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Maidah, particularly its verse on completing the religion (5:3), is widely held to be among the last revealed.

questions.prompt: What are the Makki (Makkan) Surahs?
questions.explanation: Makki Surahs were revealed before the Hijrah to Madinah; Madani Surahs after it.

questions.prompt: Which angel brought the revelation to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Angel Jibra'il (Gabriel) delivered the Quran to the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: In which month was the Quran revealed?
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed in Ramadan, the month in which fasting is prescribed (2:185).

questions.prompt: What is 'Tarteel'?
questions.explanation: Tarteel is the measured, melodious recitation of the Quran as commanded in 73:4.

questions.prompt: What is 'Hifz' in the context of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Hifz is the complete memorization of the Quran; a hafiz is one who has memorized it.

questions.prompt: Which was the first Surah revealed in full?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Fatiha is generally regarded as the first Surah revealed in full.

questions.prompt: In which battle did about 70 Huffaz (memorizers of the Quran) of the Quran get martyred, prompting its compilation?
questions.explanation: The heavy loss of Huffaz at the Battle of Yamama (633 CE) led Umar to urge the compilation of the Quran.

questions.prompt: How many Sajdah (prostration) verses are there in the Quran?
questions.explanation: There are 15 verses of Sajdah (14 by some counts; 15 including the widely accepted 15th in Surah Al-Najm).

questions.prompt: What is the meaning of the word 'Quran'?
questions.explanation: Quran derives from the root qara'a, meaning to read or recite.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called 'Al-Fatiha' for being the opening of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatiha means 'The Opening' — it is the first Surah and is recited in every unit of prayer.

questions.prompt: What is the first chapter revealed in full after the initial five verses of Al-Alaq?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Muddaththir ('O you wrapped in garments') was among the earliest full Surahs revealed.

questions.prompt: What is 'Tafsir'?
options: Interpretation and commentary of the Quran
questions.explanation: Tafsir is the scholarly explanation and commentary of Quranic verses.

questions.prompt: Which companion of the Prophet (PBUH) was called 'Sayyid-ul-Qurra' (leader of the reciters)?
questions.explanation: Ubayy bin Ka'b was renowned among the companions for his knowledge of Quranic recitation.

questions.prompt: Which small Surah is reported to equal one-third of the Quran in reward?
questions.explanation: Reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas three times is said to carry the reward of reciting the whole Quran.

questions.prompt: How many times does the word 'Bismillah' appear in the Quran in total?
questions.explanation: Bismillah appears 114 times — once at the start of every Surah except At-Tawbah, and twice in An-Naml.

questions.prompt: Which companion of the Prophet (PBUH) used to recite the Quran publicly in Makkah and was persecuted for it?
questions.explanation: Abdullah bin Masood was the first to recite the Quran aloud in the Kaaba, for which he was beaten.

questions.prompt: What is 'Ilm-ul-Tajweed'?
options: The science of correct Quranic pronunciation and recitation
questions.explanation: Tajweed is the set of rules governing the correct pronunciation of Quranic letters during recitation.

questions.prompt: The Quranic term 'Muhkamat' refers to which verses?
questions.explanation: Muhkamat are the clear, decisive verses; Mutashabihat are the allegorical ones (3:7).

questions.prompt: Who was the famous female Hafiza of the Quran among the Prophet's (PBUH) wives?
questions.explanation: Hafsa bint Umar memorized the Quran, and the compiled Mushaf was kept with her for a time.

questions.prompt: Which companion was chosen to record revelation in Madinah?
questions.explanation: Zaid bin Thabit was the chief scribe of revelation in Madinah.

questions.prompt: The Quranic script with diacritical marks was standardized by?
questions.explanation: Diacritical dots were added in the Umayyad period under Al-Hajjaj's reforms.

questions.prompt: What is the 'Asbab al-Nuzul'?
options: The occasions and reasons for revelation of verses
questions.explanation: Asbab al-Nuzul studies the contexts in which verses were revealed.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT a name of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Furqan, Adh-Dhikr and Al-Kitab are Quranic names; Al-Masbaha is not.

questions.prompt: The word 'Injil' in the Quran refers to?
options: The Gospel revealed to Prophet Isa (AS)
questions.explanation: Injil is the revelation given to Isa (AS).

questions.prompt: Which Surah is recited at the funeral prayer?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatiha is recited in the Janazah prayer.

questions.prompt: What is the term for the Quranic divisions marked for daily recitation (one-thirtieth)?
questions.explanation: The Quran is divided into 30 Juz for daily recitation.

questions.prompt: Which verse commands 'Read in the name of your Lord who created'?
questions.explanation: The first revelation, 96:1, commands reading in the name of the Lord.

questions.prompt: The Quran was compiled into the Uthmani Mushaf during which period?
questions.explanation: Uthman (RA) commissioned the official Mushaf copies between 650 and 656 CE.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called 'Al-Munjiyah' (the Saver) for interceding for its reciter?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Mulk is reported to intercede and save its reciter from the punishment of the grave.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called 'Al-Waqi'ah' (The Inevitable) and is recommended for protection from poverty?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Waqi'ah is associated with wealth protection in popular hadith tradition.

questions.prompt: Who were the first Huffaz (memorizers) of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Many companions memorized the Quran during the Prophet's (PBUH) lifetime.

questions.prompt: The Quranic term for 'the Day of Standing' before Allah is?
questions.explanation: Yaum-ul-Qiyamah is the Day of Resurrection and Judgment.

questions.prompt: Which Surah was revealed regarding the 'Ifk' (slander) incident?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Nur (24:11-20) addressed the slander against Aisha (RA).

questions.prompt: Which Surah mentions the 'Jizyah' tax for non-Muslims under Muslim rule?
questions.explanation: At-Tawbah 9:29 outlines the Jizyah arrangement.

questions.prompt: What is the 'Qira'at' of the Quran?
options: The recognized methods of recitation transmitted from the Prophet (PBUH)
questions.explanation: The ten Qira'at are the canonical recitation traditions, all authentic.

questions.prompt: Which two Surahs are called 'Az-Zahrawain' (the Two Bright Ones)?
questions.explanation: Al-Baqarah and Al-Imran are called Az-Zahrawain (the two luminous ones).

questions.prompt: Which verse is called 'Ayat al-Mubahilah' and involves the Ahl al-Bayt?
questions.explanation: 3:61 (Mubahilah) involved the Prophet (PBUH), Ali, Fatimah, Hasan and Husain.

questions.prompt: Which Surah praises the 'Ansar' and 'Muhajirin' and the conquest of Makkah?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Hashr (59:8-10) praises the emigrants and helpers.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called 'Al-Sab' al-Mathani' (the Seven Oft-Repeated)?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatiha is the seven oft-repeated verses (15:87).

questions.prompt: A 'Ruku' refers to:
questions.explanation: Ruku divides surahs into thematic sections.

questions.prompt: The Quran's verses are called:
questions.explanation: Ayat are the verses of the Quran.

questions.prompt: Which surah is revealed in full in the Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatihah was revealed in full.

questions.prompt: How many verses are in the Quran approximately?
questions.explanation: The Quran has about 6,236 verses.

questions.prompt: Which surah is the 'crown of the Quran'?
questions.explanation: Ar-Rahman is called the crown of the Quran.

questions.prompt: The 'Manzil' divides the Quran into how many parts?
questions.explanation: Manzil divides the Quran into 7 sections.

questions.prompt: The Quran was preserved through:
questions.explanation: The Quran was preserved by both memory and script.

questions.prompt: The 'Sajdah' verses in the Quran require:
questions.explanation: Sajdah tilawat is performed at these verses.

questions.prompt: The Quranic chapters revealed in Makkah are called:
questions.explanation: Makki surahs were revealed in Makkah.

questions.prompt: The surahs revealed in Madinah are called:
questions.explanation: Madani surahs came after the Hijrah.

questions.prompt: The term 'Tafsir' means:
options: Exegesis or explanation of the Quran
questions.explanation: Tafsir explains Quranic meanings.

questions.prompt: The famous Tafsir 'Tafsir Ibn Kathir' was written by:
questions.explanation: Ibn Kathir authored this renowned tafsir.

questions.prompt: The first Tafsir of the Quran was by:
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) was the first mufassir.

questions.prompt: The Quranic script used today is based on:
questions.explanation: The Uthmani script is the standard.

questions.prompt: The 'Tajweed' refers to:
questions.explanation: Tajweed governs correct pronunciation.

questions.prompt: The 'Surah Al-Ankabut' takes its name from:
questions.explanation: Al-Ankabut means the spider.

questions.prompt: Surah An-Naml takes its name from:
questions.explanation: An-Naml means the ant.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Kahf narrates the story of:
questions.explanation: Al-Kahf tells of the sleepers in the cave.

questions.prompt: The 'Fawatih' (disjointed letters) open how many surahs?
questions.explanation: 29 surahs begin with muqatta'at letters.

questions.prompt: The Cave of Hira lies on which mountain near Makkah?
questions.explanation: Cave Hira is on Jabal al-Noor (the Mountain of Light).

questions.prompt: The term 'Mushaf' refers to?
options: The bound collection of the Quranic pages
A single verse of the Quran
questions.explanation: Mushaf is the bound book form of the Quran.

questions.prompt: The Quranic principle that a later verse may replace the ruling of an earlier one is called?
questions.explanation: Naskh is the abrogation of an earlier ruling by a later revelation.

questions.prompt: The Quran was revealed in how many dialects (Ahruf) according to hadith?
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed in seven Ahruf (dialects) as a mercy.

questions.prompt: Who is credited with introducing the vowel marks (harakat) to the Quranic script?
questions.explanation: Abu al-Aswad al-Du'ali is credited with the vowel-point system.

questions.prompt: The recitations of Hafs and Warsh are examples of?
options: Two of the ten canonical Qira'at
questions.explanation: Hafs an Asim and Warsh an Nafi are two canonical Qira'at.

questions.prompt: Which Qira'ah (recitation) is the most widely used in the world today?
questions.explanation: The Hafs an Asim recitation is used by the majority of Muslims today.

questions.prompt: A 'Hizb' of the Quran is equal to?
questions.explanation: Each Juz contains two Hizb; the Quran has sixty Hizb in total.

questions.prompt: The 30th and final Juz of the Quran is popularly called?
questions.explanation: The 30th Juz is called Juz Amma after its first word.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Fatiha is also known as 'Al-Shifa', which means?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatiha is called Al-Shifa (the Cure) for its healing recitation.

questions.prompt: According to a hadith, which is the greatest Surah of the Quran?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) called Al-Fatiha the greatest Surah of the Quran.

questions.prompt: Who was the very first person to memorise the entire Quran?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) received and memorised the Quran as it was revealed.

questions.prompt: The Quran describes itself as 'Al-Furqan', meaning?
options: The Criterion (that distinguishes right from wrong)
questions.explanation: Al-Furqan is the Criterion separating truth from falsehood.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Kafirun and Surah Al-Ikhlas are together called?
questions.explanation: The two Surahs that remove hypocrisy are called Al-Muqashqishatan.

questions.prompt: The special voluntary night prayer of Ramadan, performed in congregation, is called?
questions.explanation: Tarawih is the nightly prayer of Ramadan performed after Isha.

questions.prompt: The word 'Tilawat' means?
questions.explanation: Tilawat is the act of reciting the Quran.

questions.prompt: Reciting Quranic verses for healing and protection is called?
questions.explanation: Ruqyah is the legitimate recitation of Quran for healing.

questions.prompt: The Quran is also called 'Al-Zikr', which means?
questions.explanation: Al-Zikr (the Reminder) is one of the names of the Quran.

questions.prompt: Who first suggested to Abu Bakr (RA) that the Quran be compiled into one book?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) suggested compilation after many Huffaz fell at Yamama.

questions.prompt: What is the 100th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Adiyat (the Chargers) is the 100th chapter.

questions.prompt: What is the 103rd Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Asr (Time) is the 103rd chapter.

questions.prompt: In 'Umm-ul-Kitab', the word 'Umm' means?
questions.explanation: Umm means mother; Al-Fatiha is the mother of the Book.

questions.prompt: The 'Bismillah' at the start of Surahs contains how many Arabic letters?
questions.explanation: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim contains 19 letters, matching the guardians of Hell.

questions.prompt: The entire Quran is divided into how many Hizb?
questions.explanation: Thirty Juz multiplied by two Hizb each gives sixty Hizb.

questions.prompt: Before compilation into a book, the Quran was initially preserved by writing on?
options: Bones, palm leaves and flat stones
questions.explanation: The early Muslims wrote revelation on bones, palm leaves, stones and hide.

questions.prompt: The miraculous inimitability of the Quran that no one can match is called?
questions.explanation: Ijaz al-Quran is the doctrine of the Quran's miraculous inimitability.

questions.prompt: The gradual, piecemeal revelation of the Quran is called?
questions.explanation: Tanjim refers to the Quran being revealed gradually over 23 years.

questions.prompt: In which city was the Quran first compiled into a single Mushaf under Abu Bakr (RA)?
questions.explanation: The first compilation was carried out in Madinah under Abu Bakr (RA).

questions.prompt: Which Surah was the first complete Surah to be revealed after the opening verses of Al-Alaq?
questions.explanation: After the first five verses of Al-Alaq, Surah Al-Muddaththir was revealed next.

questions.prompt: The 'Basmalah' is not recited at the beginning of which Surah?
questions.explanation: At-Tawbah is the only Surah that begins without the Bismillah.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the famous Tafsir 'Ruh al-Ma'ani'?
questions.explanation: Ruh al-Ma'ani was written by Mahmud al-Alusi.

questions.prompt: The first four verses of Surah Al-Alaq begin with the command?
questions.explanation: The first revelation begins with 'Iqra bismi Rabbik' — Read in the name of your Lord.

questions.prompt: Which companion was known as the first Muazzin and also memorised the Quran?
questions.explanation: Bilal (RA) was the first Muazzin of Islam.

questions.prompt: The 'Wahy' was first received by the Prophet (PBUH) in which month?
questions.explanation: The revelation began in the month of Ramadan on Laylat-ul-Qadr.

questions.prompt: How many times does the word 'Quran' itself appear in the Quran approximately?
questions.explanation: The word Quran appears roughly seventy times in the text.

questions.prompt: The 'Sajdah tilawah' verse found in Surah As-Sajdah is which verse?
questions.explanation: The prostration verse of Surah As-Sajdah is 32:15.
